body:
09a4b7614d. Mechanism: under git>=2.54 (CI ran 2.55.0), each fixture commit or merge starts a detached geometric auto-maintenance. Its background repack -d rmdirs emptied .git/objects/<xx> fanout dirs between git's create_tmpfile mkdir and the retried mkstemp. Raw trace2 and strace evidence is in the BUG-2118 comment.
AC1 (name the mechanism with raw evidence): trace2 shows the repack overlapping the fixture's merge; strace shows the daemonized repack pid rmdir-ing 49 fanout dirs after the fixture's git exited.
AC2 (reproduction that fails before the fix): an LD_PRELOAD mkdir-window shim under git 2.55. The unguarded fixture (as on 36c906f453) failed 5/5 with the exact error; the guarded fixture passed 5/5. Recipe is in the docs note.
AC3 (non-recurring, permanent regression): the existing guard (#2560) is the fix and is now the named NO_AUTO_MAINTENANCE. fixture_git_never_starts_auto_maintenance has an eager foreground config plus an unguarded control, and mutation-fails on git 2.43 and 2.55.
Follow-up: about 215 other unguarded test fixtures are exposed to the same race; filed as BUG-2191, which needs a sketch.
Note: my seat is advisor by session default. The code-guard hook fired once and aida role enter needs a human TTY, so I proceeded as the fixer you dispatched.
subject: PR-2771 ready (BUG-2118)
